title: Count Subarrays With Even Odd Ratio I
summary: Given an integer array nums and two integers a and b, count the number of subarrays where the ratio of even elements to odd elements is less than or equal to a/b, with the condition that there must be at least one odd element in the subarray.
statement: Given an integer array nums and two integers a and b, count the number of subarrays where the ratio of even elements to odd elements is less than or equal to a/b, with the condition that there must be at least one odd element in the subarray.
constraints: For each nonempty subarray, count its even and odd elements.
It qualifies only with at least one odd and even/odd <= a/b.
Return the number of qualifying subarrays.
hints: Fix a left boundary and extend right while maintaining parity counts.
Avoid floating point by cross-multiplying even*b <= odd*a.
Require odd to be positive before counting.
Every subarray is evaluated once with exact integer arithmetic.
editorial: Every subarray is evaluated once with exact integer arithmetic.
